title: A Hawkes Microfoundation for Multitype Inverse Gaussian Subordinators
abstract: arXiv:2610.10525v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We provide an event-level Hawkes microfoundation for a multitype inverse-Gaussian stochastic clock. We show that the event counts and integrated intensities of nearly critical multivariate linear Hawkes processes converge jointly to a multivariate pure-jump subordinator when reproduction delays have finite mean and immigration is balanced so that rare large families remain visible. The dependence among the limiting coordinates is inherited from microscopic cross-excitation, and the limit admits a Brownian additive-field first-passage representation. We call this process the multitype inverse-Gaussian subordinator. Its diagonal case consists of independent classical inverse-Gaussian subordinators, with the univariate model as a further special case. The square-root specialization recovers the inverse-Gaussian clock obtained at the boundary of hyper-rough square-root models by Abi Jaber--Attal--Rosenbaum (\textit{Ann. Appl. Probab.} \tex

translated_title: 多类型逆高斯从属过程的Hawkes微观基础
translated_abstract: 我们为多类型逆高斯随机时钟提供了一个事件级别的Hawkes微观基础。我们证明了当繁殖延迟具有有限均值且移民输入达到平衡（以使罕见的大型家族保持可见）时，近似临界的多元线性Hawkes过程的事件计数和积分强度会联合收敛到一个多元纯跳跃从属过程。极限坐标之间的依赖性继承自微观层面的交叉激发，且该极限过程具有布朗可加场首达时表示。我们将此过程称为多类型逆高斯从属过程。其对角情形由相互独立的经典逆高斯从属过程构成，而单变量模型则是其进一步的特例。平方根特化情形恢复了Abi Jaber–Attal–Rosenbaum在超粗糙平方根模型边界处得到的逆高斯时钟（《Ann. Appl. Probab.》）。
tldr: 本文证明了在繁殖延迟有限均值与平衡移民输入的条件下，近似临界的多元线性Hawkes过程的事件计数与积分强度联合收敛到具有布朗可加场首达时表示的多类型逆高斯从属过程，从而为该类随机时钟建立了事件级别的Hawkes微观基础。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes an event-level Hawkes microfoundation for multitype inverse-Gaussian subordinators, proving that nearly critical multivariate linear Hawkes processes jointly converge to a multivariate pure-jump subordinator with a Brownian additive-field first-passage representation.
